account.q: How do I reset my password?
steps: Go to Login → Forgot password.
Enter the email linked to your EngSocial account and submit.
Open the reset link in your inbox (check Spam if needed) and set a new password (8+ characters recommended).
Already signed in? Open Settings → Security, enter current password, then new password twice.
Still stuck? Email support@engsocial.vn from your registered address.

lesson.q: Where are my lessons and learning history?
steps: Open Lesson in the top menu to browse by skill, level, and topic.
Click a card → View detail → Start or Continue the lesson.
Submit answers to save score and completion automatically.
Open Lesson → History to see past attempts (date, score, time).
Check Profile for skill charts, XP, level, and badges.
Writing may show “pending review” until an instructor grades — final score updates after that.

practice.q: What is the difference between Lessons and Practice?
steps: Lessons: main structured path — longer instructor content (reading, audio, writing, quizzes).
Practice: skill drills under the Practice menu — extra R/L/W exercises, mock tests, games.
Same flow for both: study → answer → result page.
Both earn XP and count toward daily/weekly quests and active challenges.
Mock tests use a multi-part flow with a dedicated results summary.

quest.q: How do daily quests and challenges work?
steps: Quests (Quests menu): personal goals that refresh daily/weekly (lessons, friends, posts, vocab notes, online time…).
Progress bars update automatically when you complete the matching action.
Challenges (Challenge menu): time-limited events with a visible start/end date.
Visit /challenge to register — each user is counted once per challenge.
Meet the goal (lessons, score, streak, online minutes…) before the deadline to earn XP.
Long-term badges live under Achievements.

report.q: How do I report inappropriate content?
steps: On a post or comment: open ⋮ → Report.
On a user profile: use the report option on their page.
Pick a reason and add a short note if helpful.
Reports go to moderators; the reported person does not see your identity.
You get an in-app notification when the case is accepted, dismissed, or still pending.
Urgent issues: also email support@engsocial.vn with links or screenshots.

technical.q: The app is slow or not loading — what should I do?
steps: Refresh the page (Ctrl+R / Cmd+R) and close extra browser tabs.
Use an updated Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari on a stable connection.
Clear cache/cookies for this site; try Incognito without extensions.
Listening: check volume and browser autoplay permissions.
Large images or writing uploads may timeout — use smaller files.
Still failing? Email support@engsocial.vn with account email, device/browser, steps to reproduce, and a screenshot.
